onboarding:
"Tabsend Console"
"Back to tabsend.org"

"Tabsend web console"

"Tabsend sends a web page from one of your devices to another, such as from your computer to your phone. The console is a web page that lists your devices and shows what you sent. It can't send tabs itself. Use the Tabsend browser extension or phone app for that."

"New to Tabsend? " "Learn more at tabsend.org" "."

"Pair this console"

"Open Tabsend on a device you already use, choose Add a device, and paste its setup link here."
